messages:
Maria (AE): Quick sync 355 5onboarding call with TenorHealth tomorrow. Need to lock POC scope + success criteria: 3 prioritized user journeys, SSO, data residency, and pilot pricing. Can folks chime in?
Kevin (SE): I can own endpoints. Do we have sample payloads or expected doc/chat flows?
Maria (AE): They shared a deck: patient triage chat, discharge summary generation, and insurance eligibility Q/A. I'll paste snippets after this.
Kevin (SE): Triage = latency-sensitive; summaries = cost/throughput-sensitive; eligibility = retrieval + accuracy.
Ashley (PM): Draft success criteria: 
- Triage chat: p95 latency <500ms for 256-token exchanges; intent accuracy >85% on our eval set.
- Discharge summary: mean ROUGE-L >=0.45; 95% pass automated PHI redaction.
- Eligibility QA: precision >=90% on curated prompts; hallucination rate <5%.
Samir (SRE): Ops items: SAMLv2 SSO, staging IP allowlist, VPC peering (2w lead), KMS key integration, per-request audit logs.
Priya (Security): Add: data retention default 30d, on-demand purge, TLS + at-rest encryption, SOC2 attestation. Confirm whether embeddings/PII are stored.
Maria (AE): They asked for a prompt/eval plan. Can Kevin/Ashley propose ~30 prompts per journey + a scoring harness?
Kevin (SE): I'll assemble prompts. Eval harness idea: run prompts in staging vs golden answers, compute precision/recall, simple hallucination detector. Example triage prompt:
```
Patient: I've had fever and cough 3 days, now shortness of breath. What should I do?
System: <model response>
```
Include edge cases: med allergies, comorbidities.
Ashley (PM): Proposed timeline:
Day 0: kickoff + data transfer
Day 3: config + SSO creds exchanged
Day 7: first model + endpoints in staging, initial eval
Day 14: iterate prompts + run formal eval
End Week 4: demo + go/no-go
Maria (AE): Procurement wants pilot cost cap for the 4-week POC. Can we offer a fixed pilot rate?
Samir (SRE): We can propose a fixed pilot commit using reserved capacity in staging; need to validate quotas with infra. I'll confirm by EOD. Potential blocker: VPC peering org approvals may add ~5 business days.
Priya (Security): Please get their completed security questionnaire before Day 3. Need explicit data flow diagrams and third-party processor list. If they require EU-only residency, staging must be in eu-west-1 (+48h).
Kevin (SE): Endpoint matrix (minimal):
- /v1/triage -> streaming chat, 256 token limit, KV cache off for PII safety
- /v1/summarize -> batch/async, 2048 token, priority on throughput
- /v1/eligibility -> single-turn QA, embedding retrieval + rerank
I'll add expected QPS/concurrency in the doc.
Maria (AE): They want fallback behavior if primary model hits capacity. Can we commit to automatic fallback to a quantized model with the same API?
Samir (SRE): Yes, routing policy configurable: primary -> fallback quantized in-region. Documented expected quality delta (~3-5% metric drop for summaries).
Ashley (PM): Acceptance checklist to share with client: 1) Endpoints live in staging + SSO validated; 2) Eval harness meets thresholds; 3) Security questionnaire reviewed; 4) Pilot pricing agreed; 5) Rollback/escape hatches documented (fallback model + throttling).
Maria (AE): Action items: Kevin - compile 30 prompts/journey + payload shapes by EOD. Samir - confirm pilot commit/quota + fallback ETA. Priya - send security questionnaire to TenorHealth and request answers by Day 3. Ashley - finalize acceptance criteria doc and share. I'll coordinate kickoff.
Kevin (SE): On it, will post prompts to the shared sales drive and link here.
Samir (SRE): Pinging infra now. Noted potential VPC peering delay.
Priya (Security): If embeddings are optional, set embeddings.write=false by default for the POC and require explicit opt-in.
ops-bot: deploy-staging started for tenor-poc-staging (build 2026.3) :rocket:
Maria (AE): Thanks team 55. I'll update TenorHealth once prompts are posted. :thumbsup:
